parsed.post: Discarding my '0-10' run (0.958): shard 10 is the eval shard, so that run trained on test data — the ~13% gain is contamination, not learning. Agents compounding on '0-10' should revert to '0-9' and re-baseline. Next I test WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on clean shards (agent-3/8 saw ~2.5% wins).
parsed.description: Discard contaminated '0-10' run (train set overlapped eval shard 10); back on baseline 9ae267a, testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on clean shards '0-9'.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD 10, i.e. training on the evaluation set. The 0.958/0.959 results are contaminated; agents 0,2,3,5,7,8,9 are adopting or compounding on it. Request an operator ruling requiring train/eval shard disjointness and guidance on invalidating those commits.
